view_title: Column grid master for บ้านต้านภัยพิบัติแผ่นดินไหว 1 (แบบบ้านสานฝัน ของขวัญปีใหม่ คนไทยมีความสุข) -- derived from S-02 แปลนฐานรากแผ่ (PNG 23 / printed 21). Main grid 4 x 6, 9.60 m x 14.55 m overall, plus 4 dummy x-lines and 1 dummy y-line required by the S-04 porch/partition beams, positions printed on A-04.

x_lines.source: A-04 top chain prints 1.00 west of grid 1; the B1 (S-04) / RB0 (S-05) porch edge beam runs E->D on this line
A-04 sub-chain 1.90|1.30 inside bay 1-2; the B1 partition beam (S-04) runs E->D on this line (WC.1 east wall)
A-04 sub-chain 1.30|1.90 inside bay 3-4 (mirror of 2'); the B1 partition beam (S-04) runs E->D on this line (WC.2 west wall)
A-04 top chain prints 1.00 east of grid 4; the B1 (S-04) / RB0 (S-05) porch edge beam runs E->D on this line

y_lines.source: A-04 prints 3.10 from grid E up to the kitchen north wall; the B2 beam (S-04) runs on this line from grid 1 to grid 2 only
